title: Pentaryn Token Name Sync
description: Renaming an actor renames its token labels to match: the prototype token and every placed token of that actor, on every scene. A token whose label was the actor's full name, or the part before the first comma ('Glubbek' for 'Glubbek, Kuo-toa Net-Mender'), follows the rename in the same form. A label that is anything else is a deliberate nickname and is left alone. Exposes game.pentaryn.names.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), then reload.
